description: Implementation of EmployeeService for managing Employee entities - includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employees.

classes.name: EmployeeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing EmployeeService interface to manage Employee entities.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee by ID using the EmployeeRepository.

methods.name: updateEmployee
methods.description: Updates an existing Employee if it exists; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: deleteEmployee
methods.description: Deletes an existing Employee by ID if found; throws exception if not found.
